group: OmniRoute S02/S03/S05/S06/S07 — read-only resolution, 2026-09-27. Checkout HEAD verified as dd6e9607e4884ec75c9bc0d96e60b01e9483d84e. Configurations below are proposals; no settings, processes or files were changed.

items.what_it_does: Exposes routing/search, health/quota/usage, configuration, cache/compression, memory/skills, plugins and external context operations. The stated 45 tools are the canonical definitions: pinned documentation counts 110 built-in tools across modules; enabled database skills can add skill_* tools. Supports stdio, SSE and Streamable HTTP.
items.defaults: mcpEnabled=false; transport resolves to stdio. Tool-cardinality filtering is inactive without MCP_TOOL_ALLOW/MCP_TOOL_DENY. Description compression defaults enabled. HTTP enablement and launching the independent stdio process are separate controls.
items.controls: Settings mcpEnabled and mcpTransport; client MCP registration and omniroute --mcp process lifecycle; MCP_TOOL_ALLOW/MCP_TOOL_DENY; OMNIROUTE_MCP_ENFORCE_SCOPES and OMNIROUTE_MCP_SCOPES. Description controls: compression.mcpDescriptionCompressionEnabled or OMNIROUTE_MCP_COMPRESS_DESCRIPTIONS=false.
items.current_live_value: Supplied GET snapshot: enabled=false, online=false, transport=stdio, scopesEnforced=false, totalCalls24h=0; MCP description compression=true. Reported offline status does not independently prove that no separately launched stdio process exists.
items.applies_to: No MCP consumer is required by the stated CX, FW or SEARCH interfaces. A separate operator administration consumer could use a narrow catalog.
items.quality_risk: omniroute_route_request constructs model/messages/stream:false plus optional x-combo; it omits effort, tools and response_format, then extracts textual output. It cannot preserve CX native Responses or FW strict-schema/tool semantics. With login disabled, management authentication is bypassed; disabled scope enforcement permits tool calls. Enabling HTTP MCP therefore adds a powerful interface for local processes. Routine usage polling also conflicts with the supplied no-GPT-6-usage-narration rule.
items.cache_effect: Inference: leaving this server unregistered adds no tool schemas to lane prefixes. Loading a large or changing catalog can disturb prefix continuity; stable schemas may subsequently cache. Description compression changes tool-selection context and has no demonstrated quality parity here.
items.token_effect: No demonstrated lane savings. Schemas and tool results add input context when surfaced; exact cost requires the client's actual serialized manifest. With approximately 94% input cache reads and only approximately 1.2% output tokens, avoiding unnecessary input context is the relevant consideration.
items.upstream_status: GitHub API checked: scope-enforcement correction PR #2958 merged 2026-05-31; mcp:connect authentication issue #9159 closed 2026-08-08. These fixes do not make the current keyless, scopes-disabled posture isolated.
items.proposed_config: Gateway settings {"mcpEnabled":false,"mcpTransport":"stdio"}; omit OmniRoute MCP registrations from CX/FW/SEARCH clients and do not launch omniroute --mcp. mcpEnabled=false gates HTTP transports but does not prevent a separately launched stdio server. GET /api/mcp/tools can still expose metadata while execution is disabled.
items.experiment_needed: None to retain OFF. Before reconsideration, identify an operator task, expose only its required tools through MCP_TOOL_ALLOW, and measure actual schema tokens, tool-selection accuracy and total task cost. Do not route lane inference through omniroute_route_request without effort/schema/tool parity evidence.
items.overturn_condition: A concrete administration consumer demonstrates net benefit with a narrow catalog and an acceptable trust boundary. Preserve native CX/FW inference and keep usage narration outside worker context.

items.what_it_does: Provides JSON-RPC agent tasks with six implemented skills: smart-routing, quota-management, provider-discovery, cost-analysis, health-report and list-capabilities. Agent Card discovery can additionally advertise Conductor fleet skills.
items.defaults: a2aEnabled=false. Authentication permits keyless callers when neither required gateway-key authentication nor the legacy explicit A2A key is configured. Ownerless tasks are intentionally shared.
items.controls: a2aEnabled gates task execution; REQUIRE_API_KEY and the optional legacy OMNIROUTE_API_KEY affect authentication. CONDUCTOR_HUB_URL controls conditional fleet discovery. Disabling task execution does not disable the public Agent Card.
items.current_live_value: Supplied GET /api/a2a/status snapshot: enabled=false, online=false, status=disabled, skills=[], total tasks=0, active streams=0.
items.applies_to: No A2A consumer appears in the supplied CX/FW/SEARCH traffic inventory.
items.quality_risk: smart-routing reconstructs a nonstreaming chat request from model/messages/optional combo, omitting effort, tools and response_format. Substituting it for existing lanes would lose required semantics. Keyless task access does not provide local caller isolation.
items.cache_effect: No prompt or cache-prefix effect while unused. Converting native traffic into A2A smart-routing would change its request contract; cache continuity cannot be assumed.
items.token_effect: No token saving for the stated lanes. Agent discovery and task artifacts would add context only if consumed; no such consumer is established.
items.upstream_status: GitHub API checked: dashboard A2A authentication issue #12888 closed/completed 2026-09-12; fix PR #13271 merged 2026-09-12. The inspected authentication helper contains the dashboard-session fallback.

items.experiment_needed: None without a consumer. A future consumer needs task ownership, cancellation/streaming and full request-contract tests before any lane adoption.
items.overturn_condition: A named runtime requires A2A and demonstrates useful task interoperability without replacing native effort/schema/tool contracts or introducing unacceptable shared-task access.

items.feature: Middleware hooks, guardrails, prompt-injection guard and vision bridge
items.what_it_does: Pre-request JavaScript hooks can change bodies/models or short-circuit requests. The guardrail registry runs vision, audio, video, PII, prompt-injection and credential guards. Both CX and FW pass through pre-call guardrails and hooks before provider dispatch; native Responses passthrough does not bypass this stage.
items.defaults: Vision bridge=true, auto mode, default describe model openai/gpt-4o-mini; audio bridge=true; video=false. Input inspection=true; request PII, response PII and credential rewriting are opt-in. Important mismatch: the feature-flag definition reports INJECTION_GUARD_MODE default off, but the evaluator falls through DB override, environment, legacy INPUT_SANITIZER_MODE, then warn. Even explicit off does not stop scanning; INPUT_SANITIZER_ENABLED=false does.
items.controls: Hooks have enabled, priority and global/combo scope. However, the sole chat call invokes runHooks(hookContext) without comboId, so the advertised combo scope is not a verified working lane selector here. Guardrails accept an opt-out list through x-omniroute-disabled-guardrails, body/metadata.disabledGuardrails or key metadata. Early route injection checks do not reliably inherit that registry skip. Modality settings and PII/credential flags control rewriting; INPUT_SANITIZER_ENABLED is read directly from environment.
items.current_live_value: Fresh anonymous GET /api/middleware/hooks on 2026-09-27 returned hooks=[], dbCount=0, registryCount=0. Supplied snapshot: INPUT_SANITIZER_ENABLED=true/default; INJECTION_GUARD_MODE=off/default; PII_REDACTION_ENABLED=false; PII_RESPONSE_SANITIZATION=false; credentialRedactionEnabled=false. Modality settings are absent, so source defaults apply. Actual legacy sanitizer mode and credential environment override are unverified.
items.applies_to: CX and FW, including native Responses requests. The detector is also reused by other API routes.
items.quality_risk: Any admitted local process can register hooks under the accepted login-off posture. The isolated-realm fix removes the identified escape but still requires trusted hook authors. Rewriting can alter extraction entities, tool arguments, images or model choice; regex block mode can reject legitimate quoted instructions/code. Guardrails generally fail open on errors. Ordinary text requests have no bridge rewrite, and catalog-recognized native-vision models skip vision conversion; this is not proof of whole-pipeline byte identity.
items.cache_effect: Inspection-only warn/log behavior does not rewrite prompt content. Hooks, masks and image descriptions can change cached prefixes; changing routing can also move cache ownership. That risk matters substantially more than speculative shortening with approximately 94% cached input.
items.token_effect: Regex inspection needs no model call. Vision describe performs additional inference and replaces images with generated text; it is neither lossless nor demonstrated token saving for these native multimodal lanes.
items.upstream_status: GitHub API verified PR #14916 merged 2026-09-27 at the cited base pin, fixing GHSA-9p9m-h9rj-rhhg through isolated realms and JSON-only crossing. PR #11936 merged 2026-08-30 to remove duplicate injection logs. Vision fallback issue #8430 closed 2026-08-05; source still intentionally substitutes unavailable-image text on certain failed nonvision-combo paths.
items.proposed_config: Keep the hook registry empty. Settings {"modalityBridgeVisionEnabled":false,"visionBridgeEnabled":false,"modalityBridgeAudioEnabled":false,"modalityBridgeVideoEnabled":false,"modalityBridgeVideoAudioTranscriptionEnabled":false,"credentialRedactionEnabled":false}. Feature-flag overrides {"INJECTION_GUARD_MODE":"off","PII_REDACTION_ENABLED":"false","PII_RESPONSE_SANITIZATION":"false"}; service environment INPUT_SANITIZER_ENABLED=false, PII_REDACTION_ENABLED=false, CREDENTIAL_REDACTION_ENABLED=false. A dashboard-only INPUT_SANITIZER_ENABLED override is insufficient for its direct environment reader. No verified master hook-registration disable exists: empty hooks preserves current behavior but does not close the accepted local management trust boundary.
items.experiment_needed: Before any future opt-in: demonstrate a working positive lane selector, compare complete CX/FW request bodies and model/effort, replay strict JSON/schema/tool tasks plus benign injection-like text, and measure image fidelity, cache reads and total inference tokens. No such replay was run in this GET-only review.

items.feature: Telemetry, cloud sync, updates, remote mode and tunnels
items.what_it_does: Local telemetry records request timings/counters. Separately, Next.js includes framework telemetry; cloud sync exports configuration and credentials; CLI/dashboard update checks contact upstream services; remote mode directs CLI management to another server; Cloudflare, ngrok and Tailscale Funnel can publish the local gateway.
items.defaults: cloudEnabled=true but sync requires CLOUD_URL or NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUD_URL; tailscaleEnabled=false. Main CLI listener defaults to 0.0.0.0 unless overridden. Installed Next 16.3.5 telemetry defaults enabled when its configuration store is available; NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER controls the installed notifier's daily check. Update installation requires an explicit application request; checking and applying are distinct.
items.controls: cloudEnabled plus cloud URL environment; NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED; dependency-level NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER; listener host variables; CLI OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL/context; tunnel process lifecycle. OMNIROUTE_CLOUD_SYNC_SECRETS=false restricts inbound credential replacement, not outbound export. OMNIROUTE_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER only suppresses notification output. AUTO_UPDATE_MODE=off is invalid and normalizes to npm.
items.current_live_value: Supplied snapshot: cloudEnabled=true, cloudConfigured=false, cloudUrl=null; tailscaleEnabled=false, tailscaleUrl=""; local telemetry populated. Version channel=source, autoUpdateSupported=false with a not-a-git-repository error. This is a deployment condition, not an update-check disable. Recorded host evidence places listeners on loopback. Tunnel processes, CLI context and telemetry/notifier environment values are not established by the snapshot.
items.applies_to: Host-wide control plane and deployment lifecycle; ordinary CX/FW/SEARCH provider traffic remains necessary and separate.
items.quality_risk: Cloud outbound bundles include provider access/refresh credentials and gateway API keys. Unconfigured cloud currently prevents that destination-specific export; enabling a destination changes the privacy boundary. Tunnels defeat the chosen loopback exposure boundary. Automatic application of a different build could change all lanes. Next telemetry concerns build/development metadata; ongoing production telemetry emission was not demonstrated.
items.cache_effect: Inference: disabling optional telemetry/sync/exposure needs no prompt rewrite. Preserving the pinned build and route configuration protects existing cache behavior; updates or synchronized routing changes could alter it.
items.token_effect: No demonstrated model-token saving from these features. Retain local telemetry for measured A/B comparisons; it does not require injecting usage reports into model context.
items.upstream_status: GitHub API checked: insecure-defaults issue #13679 remains open; cloud signature PR #13804 merged 2026-09-16, but unsigned/no-secret legacy acceptance remains at this pin. Updater classification issue #14782 remains open and resembles the snapshot symptom; identical host root cause is unproved.
items.proposed_config: Settings {"cloudEnabled":false,"tailscaleEnabled":false,"tailscaleUrl":""}. Unset CLOUD_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUD_URL. Set NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 for build/development/service environments and NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 for CLI/service environments. Keep OMNIROUTE_SERVER_HOST=API_HOST=LIVE_WS_HOST=EMBED_WS_PROXY_HOST=127.0.0.1; pin CLI OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:20128. Keep every tunnel backend stopped and do not select a remote CLI context. Optional cloud defense: OMNIROUTE_CLOUD_SYNC_SECRETS=false and OMNIROUTE_CLOUD_SYNC_ENFORCE_SIGNATURE=true. Residual: no verified existing setting disables dashboard /api/system/version and news fetches; complete OFF for that surface requires a narrowly scoped source guard or equivalent egress control. Neither was implemented. Hidden tunnel cards are not disable controls.
items.experiment_needed: Verify effective nonsecret flag values, bound addresses and stopped tunnel state; observe egress separately during service startup, dashboard use and builds while allowing intended provider/search traffic. Verify zero cloud/notifier/framework-telemetry traffic under proposed flags. Dashboard update/news suppression remains an implementation requirement.
items.overturn_condition: A specific remote/sync consumer justifies off-host disclosure or exposure with an accepted security design. Updates require explicit pin review and CX/FW regression/cache evidence. Retaining local metrics needs no overturn.

items.feature: Gateway memory, skills and system/context injection
items.what_it_does: Built-in memory extracts/stores preferences and decisions, retrieves context and can add memory tools. Omni Skills inject executable tool schemas. Agent Skills are a separate discovery catalog, not automatic Markdown injection. Two independent system-prompt features exist: customSystemPrompt and global prefix/suffix systemPrompt. External context tools include Notion, Obsidian and Local Corpus.
items.defaults: Memory disabled, approximate 2,000-token retrieval budget, 30-day retention, hybrid retrieval and SQLite primary backend; skillsEnabled=true independently. Transformer/static embeddings and reranking default disabled. Custom and global system-prompt injection are disabled when unset.
items.controls: /api/settings/memory controls enabled and skillsEnabled; settings customSystemPromptEnabled/customSystemPrompt control custom instructions; /api/settings/system-prompt controls enabled/prefixPrompt/suffixPrompt. x-omniroute-no-memory:true suppresses memory and skills through null ownership; it does not disable either system-prompt feature and is an opt-out rather than a positive lane enable.
items.current_live_value: Snapshot: customSystemPromptEnabled=false and customSystemPrompt=""; memory/skills/global-system keys absent. Fresh GETs on 2026-09-27 confirmed memory enabled=false, skillsEnabled=true, maxTokens=2000, retentionDays=30, hybrid, SQLite, no fallback backends, transformersEnabled=false, rerankEnabled=false; global system prompt enabled=false with empty prefix/suffix.
items.applies_to: For genuinely keyless requests, missing API-key ownership prevents memory/skill injection and durable extraction in CX/FW. Native CX input[] also fails the memory-retrieval messages[] gate. A valid-key, nonstreaming FW request can receive installed skill schemas even with memory disabled. Global system-prompt injection can alter Responses instructions if enabled.
items.quality_risk: Gateway retrieval and executable skills add another context/tool authority to CX and to FW runtimes that already own memory. The repository explicitly retains ai-memory/code-index responsibilities and prohibits competing gateway chains. Important existing behavior: injectMemoryAndSkills sorts any tools array with more than one entry even when memory/skills are off or ownership is null. Native Responses passthrough then uses that current body. Disabling injection therefore does not certify original client tool-order byte identity; this is existing baseline behavior, not a new proposed rewrite.
items.cache_effect: Memory placement is cache-preserving only when its explicit cache_control detection selects that path; otherwise context can be prepended, and provider constraints can force leading placement. Provider cache-read counters and four-hour affinity do not prove that placement gate is active. Retrieved text, tool selection and global instructions can change prefixes.
items.token_effect: Eligible memory retrieval can add approximately 2,000 input tokens under defaults; skill schemas add unmeasured input and tool choices. No net savings or quality improvement was demonstrated against the input-heavy, approximately 94%-cached workload.
items.upstream_status: GitHub API verified PR #13414 merged 2026-09-15: eval runner opts out of memory/skills and output-style injection because injected context affected evaluation results. PR #13427 merged the same day to correct Anthropic memory placement. These fixes do not establish CX/FW prefix or quality parity.
items.proposed_config: Desired supported payloads: /api/settings/memory {"enabled":false,"skillsEnabled":false}; /api/settings {"customSystemPromptEnabled":false,"customSystemPrompt":""}; /api/settings/system-prompt {"enabled":false,"prefixPrompt":"","suffixPrompt":"","prompt":""}. Keep ai-memory, code indexes and FW-owned memory unchanged. If a lane later sends a real gateway key, x-omniroute-no-memory:true provides an additional opt-out. These settings disable added content; they do not disable the existing unconditional tool sort.
items.experiment_needed: None to retain OFF. Any future memory/skill trial must be isolated to its consumer and compare extraction/graph accuracy, strict-schema/tool completion, total input tokens and cache-read ratio. Separately capture unsorted-tool CX/FW wire requests to quantify the existing sort and verify baseline continuity. No inference requests were issued.
items.overturn_condition: A specific lane proves a retrieval/skill benefit that its native memory layer cannot supply, with acceptable total cost and unchanged unselected requests. Positive lane enablement must be verified; the no-memory header alone does not provide that contract.
